status_meanings.declaration_only: Consumed by the case layer, compiler, or evidence system; not a setting.
status_meanings.implemented: Compiles to a supported adapter operation for the documented conditions.
status_meanings.not_applicable: Metadata with no Fluent or PyFluent setting counterpart.
status_meanings.partial: Only the documented options or prerequisites are implemented.
status_meanings.planned: Typed intent is accepted, but no automatic PyFluent mutation exists yet.
